chunks: And from him, from Abu Khalid al-Qammam, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
The Tasbih of Fatimah (peace be upon her), recited every day after each prayer, is more beloved to me than the prayer of one thousand rak'ahs performed every day.

key_terms.تَسْبِيحُ فَاطِمَةَ: The specific set of praises attributed to Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her)

ai.seo_question: What is the merit of reciting Tasbih Fatimah after prayer?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the recitation of the 'Tasbih of Fatimah' after every obligatory prayer above the merit of performing a thousand voluntary rak'ahs daily, underscoring its status as a concise yet profound spiritual practice. This comparison highlights the Shia emphasis on the quality and specific divine instruction of dhikr over mere quantity in voluntary worship, linking the believer's daily routine directly to the legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt.
